title: Magic Ring
description: Start circular projects with a tight center instead of a visible hole.

content.summary: The magic ring gives you an adjustable center for granny squares and round motifs.
content.whyItMatters: It makes circular projects look cleaner and more finished.
steps: Wrap the yarn into a loose ring around your fingers.
Insert the hook through the ring and pull up a loop.
Work stitches into the ring, then pull the tail to close the center.
content.practice: Make three magic rings and close each one fully.
commonMistakes: Securing the ring too loosely before stitching into it.
Pulling the tail before enough stitches are anchored.
